01 / 06EVIDENCE. UNDERSTANDING. ACTION.

Web / app / CRM

Start with the evidence.

Map customer interactions, transactions and campaign signals, with consent and ownership in context.

Identity / CDP

Analytics / insight

Segmentation

Reporting / learning

ILLUSTRATIVE JOURNEY

FROM STRATEGY TO IMPLEMENTATION

Data intelligence.
Ready for action.

01

Build a trusted customer foundation.

Data unification, customer profiles, identity resolution and CDP strategy. Start with useful sources, dependable identifiers and clear ownership of the customer context.

02

Turn understanding into an audience.

Behavioral segments, lifecycle audiences, real-time audiences and activation. Define who should receive an experience and why, within the permissions your business has established.

03

Make performance understandable.

Dashboards, marketing reporting, customer analytics, campaign performance and business intelligence. Give teams useful views of the questions they need to answer.

04

Measure the journey that matters.

Marketing measurement, funnel performance and journey measurement, with attribution where applicable. Agree the definitions, limitations and decisions each measure should support.

05

Put intelligence into the experience.

CRM and marketing automation activation, personalization and trigger-based engagement. Connect a relevant audience or insight to a useful action in the systems teams already use.

06

Make the data ready for real work.

Data quality, consent, governance and operational readiness. Establish the checks, responsibilities and working practices that keep customer data useful.

07

Find the next useful pattern.

Predictive insight, pattern identification, next-best-action thinking and AI-assisted analysis where applicable. Match the method to the available evidence and keep interpretation grounded in business context.

Technology connects the data. Experience is where its value becomes visible.
